J=$(nproc); M=$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print int($2/2097152)}' /proc/meminfo); [ "$M" -ge 1 ] || M=1; [ "$M" -lt "$J" ] && J=$M; echo "compiling with $J parallel jobs"; cmake --build build --parallel "$J"

cmake --install build --component Test --prefix /tmp/test-component && (cd /tmp/test-component && find . \( -type f -o -type l \) -print0) | (cd /usr/local/mariadb && xargs -0 -r rm -f) && rm -rf /tmp/test-component
source._note: The `mysql` command is a two-line /bin/sh wrapper that execs `mariadb`, not upstream's compat symlink: syft's mysql-binary classifier globs **/mysql, read the symlinked MariaDB client as Oracle MySQL 12.3.4 (cpe oracle:mysql), and grype matched Oracle's MySQL advisories to it (chain 1101, 2026-11-17: 4 high and 42 medium findings, none of them MariaDB's; the 26.x ranges Oracle added 2026-10 take in every MariaDB version). `mariadb` itself is still catalogued as mariadb@<version> (cpe mariadb:mariadb), so MariaDB's own CVEs are matched; Docker's official image ships no mysql* names at all. WITH_LIBAIO=ON with no liburing-dev: InnoDB uses libaio, never io_uring (Docker's default seccomp profile blocks io_uring). PLUGIN_AUTH_SOCKET=STATIC: the health check authenticates as mysql@localhost through unix_socket. libedit-dev: the client's line editor; MariaDB refuses system readline 6+ (GPLv3) unless NOT_FOR_DISTRIBUTION. SOURCE_REVISION=@COMMIT@ is expanded by gen_dockerfile from source.commit, so @@version_source_revision names the upstream commit although the build tree has no .git. git is deliberately NOT a build package. The Test install component (mariadb-test, mariadb-client-test, their man pages) is installed into a scratch prefix only to learn its file list, then removed.
